daily.description: The available spend limit (in cents) relative to the daily limit configured on the Account (e.g. 100000 would be a $1,000 limit).

lifetime.description: The available spend limit (in cents) relative to the lifetime limit configured on the Account.

monthly.description: The available spend limit (in cents) relative to the monthly limit configured on the Account.

daily.description: The configured daily spend limit (in cents) on the Account.

lifetime.description: The configured lifetime spend limit (in cents) on the Account.

monthly.description: The configured monthly spend limit (in cents) on the Account.
